notes: Site: ikiru.in (Shopify, India). Access: direct HTTP fetch throughout, HTTP 200, no WAF/block; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Discovery: fetched full /collections.json (965 collections across 4 pages), /pages.json (100 pages), homepage nav links, and /search/suggest.json for 'new in'/'new arrivals'/'just in'/'just launched'/'latest'/'whats new' terms. Main nav explicitly links /collections/new-arrivals (handle 'new-arrivals', title 'New Arrivals'), the single clear match. Qty method: exhaustive unique-product-ID count via /collections/new-arrivals/products.json?limit=250 paged to exhaustion (12 pages, last page <250) = 2767 unique product IDs; this exactly matches the number the rendered page itself displays ('2767 products'). Sanity-checked against site scale: the product sitemap is split across 8 shard files (sitemap_products_1..8.xml), so 2767 is a plausible subset of total catalog, not the whole catalog mislabeled as 'new'. Investigated and rejected candidates: 'just-launched-utility-collection-🎉' (handle literally contains 'just-launched', 355 products) -- opened the live page and its actual <title>/meta description identify it as a generic 'Buy Home Utility & Storage Products Online' category page with an 'Up to 40% off' promo, with no framing as newly-added/recently-arrived stock; excluded as a mislabeled generic category+promo page, not a genuine New Arrivals PLP. 'new-festive-launches' (title field 'Best sellers in decor', meta description mentions 'Fresh arrivals on ikiru.in') -- the live page is actually a 'Birthday Collection' one-year-anniversary discount campaign ('upto 40% OFF sitewide discounts. Month long offers till end of November'), a temporary marketing campaign, not a catalog-level new-arrivals listing; excluded. No genuine sub-structure (e.g. 'Furniture New Arrivals') was found anywhere in the 965-collection list.

rows.evidence: Rendered page displays '2767 products'; confirmed via exhaustive /collections/new-arrivals/products.json?limit=250 paging to exhaustion (2767 unique product IDs, last page returned <250)
